title: Give a final reporting step when an exact local mailbox locator is still refused
outcome: The unknown-local-locator read error gives a bounded next step when a locator copied exactly from a host list or wake is still rejected, without claiming metadata loss or adding repair.
acceptance: The local-home unknown_native_mailbox_locator guidance tells the caller to report a refusal of an exactly copied locator, preserving current status, ownership checks and absence of automatic repair.
